proposals.evidence: Tentative historical compound analysis of āmras fish: water + fish, continuing the older Dameli âu-mraċ explicitly cited in CDIAL 9758. CDIAL 407 independently attests Dameli âu water. The fish member belongs to section 1 mátsya, not section 2 *matsiya. Turner explicitly leaves the r unexplained; the modern contraction and final s also need review. Compare Ashkun mōċ, Waigali maċ and Prasun tōā-müsū; these establish related material but no Nuristani donor direction. Component edges here identify historical etyma, not independently attested modern Dameli simplex mras.

approval: User: approve all; prefer Pashto where best matched, then Urdu for broadly Perso-Arabic terms. Approval includes qualified analyses, not a claim that uncertainties are resolved.
donor_policy: Prefer an attested Pashto donor where form and meaning fit best; otherwise prefer Urdu for broadly shared Perso-Arabic loans. Preserve explicit source attribution, phonological uncertainty and possible Nuristani mediation. Do not substitute a different dialect merely because its node is linkable.
